dimension_notes.composition_quality: Native 16:9 landscape composition centred on the table gathering with generous soft lavender negative space at top and sides; nothing clipped. Right plant leaf sits slightly close (~2%) to the right edge.
dimension_notes.message_clarity: Welcoming Indian neighbourhood courtyard gathering is immediately recognizable in under three seconds.
dimension_notes.illustration_quality: Consistent clean outlines, rounded friendly proportions, expressive simplified faces, and clean hands across all three figures; zero extra fingers or uncanny anatomy.
dimension_notes.text_accuracy: No text, lettering, or fabricated logo present, matching user requirement.
dimension_notes.technical_quality: Clean edges and smooth flat fills. Native generation was 1376x768 (within 0.8% of 16:9); finished cleanly at exact 1920x1080 PNG (1.395x upscale, well under 2x).
